exercises.notes: Max (6–10). Full range, no kipping. No warm-up set.

exercises.name: Rowing
exercises.cues: Neutral spine; drive elbow back; squeeze shoulder blades; control return.

exercises.name: Chest Press
exercises.cues: Scaps retracted; elbows ~45°; slow lower; press through mid-palm; no bounce.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cues: Lean back slightly; pull elbows to ribs; no swaying; full stretch at top.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.cues: Brace core; no lower-back arch; press slightly forward; control descent.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.cues: Elbows fixed; full supination; slow eccentric; avoid swinging torso.

exercises.name: Triceps Press
exercises.cues: Keep elbows tucked; full lockout; control the bottom; no shoulder shrug.

exercises.name: Ab Machine
exercises.cues: Control tempo; full ROM; stable core; smooth breathing.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cues: Ribs down; glutes squeezed; neutral neck; steady breathing.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.cues: Control tempo; full ROM; stable core; smooth breathing.

exercises.name: Stairs
exercises.cues: Upright torso; full steps; steady breathing.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cues: Feet mid-sled; knees track toes; full depth without pelvis tilt; drive through heels.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cues: Pad above ankles; control up 1–2s; pause squeeze; slow 2–3s down.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.cues: Hips down; neutral spine; pull to full knee flexion; control eccentric.

exercises.name: Abduction
exercises.cues: Neutral pelvis; slight forward lean; move from hip; avoid rolling torso.

exercises.name: Adduction
exercises.cues: Tall posture; squeeze inner thighs; slow eccentric; avoid knee cave.

exercises.name: Calf Raises (Leg Press)
exercises.equipment: Calf Raises on Leg Press (Star Trac)
exercises.cues: Full stretch; pause; strong plantar flexion; no bouncing; knees soft.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.cues: Scaps retracted; elbows ~45°; slow lower; press through mid-palm; no bounce.

exercises.name: One-Arm DB Row
exercises.cues: Neutral spine; drive elbow back; squeeze shoulder blades; control return.

exercises.name: Overhead DB Press
exercises.cues: Brace core; elbows slightly forward; control descent; no lower-back arch.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups (BW)
exercises.cues: Full range, no kipping; pull elbows to ribs.

exercises.name: Dips (BW)
exercises.cues: Controlled, no bounce; full ROM; stable core.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raises
exercises.cues: Posterior tilt; raise knees with abs; minimize swing; slow lower.
